_readme: This file is the whole site. Edit it, run 'python build.py', refresh. Text fields support **bold**, *italic*, [link](https://…) and newlines.

site.description: Joyal Joy Madeckal and Anjana Raju invite you to their ring exchange, their wedding, and the reception in Trivandrum. Details and RSVP.

invitation.preamble: Together with the blessings of our families
invitation.lead: With hearts full of joy, we invite you to celebrate with us.
invitation.body: PLACEHOLDER — two or three sentences in your own words. Anjana is the daughter of Raju C & Mini S S; Joyal is the son of Joy Mathew & Emily Joy, Madeckal house, Muvattupuzha. Three celebrations across a week — come to whichever you can.

functions.name: Ring Exchange Ceremony
functions.tagline: An evening with family and close friends.

functions.name: Post Wedding Reception
functions.tagline: A celebration back home, for everyone in and around Trivandrum.

details.title: Good to know
details.intro: The same for all three celebrations unless noted.

items.description: PLACEHOLDER — see the label on each event above. The wedding reception is on grass, so heels will sink.
PLACEHOLDER — parking, nearest station, shuttle times.
PLACEHOLDER — a hotel or two near the wedding venue, plus any block-booking code.
PLACEHOLDER — say plainly whether kids are invited, and whether that differs between the two events.
PLACEHOLDER — registry link, or a sentence saying your presence is enough.
PLACEHOLDER — e.g. phones away during the ceremony, then share everything after.

_gifts_readme: Leave upi.id blank and the whole gifts section disappears — nav link and all. Fill it in when you're ready. The QR is generated by build.py from these values; you don't need a screenshot from PhonePe.

gifts.title: Gifts
gifts.intro: Your being there is genuinely the whole point — please don't feel any obligation here.
gifts.body: PLACEHOLDER — one or two sentences. Something like: we're setting up a home and saving for a honeymoon, so if you'd like to give something, a contribution towards that would mean a lot.
gifts.qrCaption: Scan with PhonePe, GPay, Paytm or any UPI app
gifts.copyHint: If the QR won't scan, tap this and paste the UPI ID into your app.
gifts.footnote: Any UPI app works — it doesn't have to be PhonePe.

registry.lead: Or, if you'd rather send something for the house:
registry.label: Open our registry
registry.note: Opens MyRegistry in a new tab.

rsvp.title: Will you join us?
rsvp.intro: Reply for each celebration separately — you're welcome at any or all of them. Please let us know by **PLACEHOLDER DATE**. One form per household is fine.
rsvp.note: We'll email you a confirmation. Change of plans? Just reply to that email.

labels.name: Your name
labels.song: A song that will get you dancing

messages.sent: Thank you — we've got your reply.
messages.failed: That didn't send. Please email us instead and we'll add you by hand.
